title: ESIC Kollam Notification 2026 - Walk-in-Interview for 27 Specialist, Senior Residents and Other Posts
description: Employees' State Insurance Corporation (ESIC) Kollam has announced the official notification for 2026. To fill vacancies for 27 Specialist and Senior Resident posts. Candidates who have qualified in MBBS, BDS, MD/ MS, BDS, Post Graduation, and M.Ch can use this chance and apply for the ESIC Kollam Notification 2026 . Here, we have included the age limit, selection process, salary structure, education details, application fee, and how to apply for these posts. Interested and eligible candidate...
